── PROBE MADE MECHANICAL 2026-10-05 (owner-gated prep). The manual probe is replaced by a cmd probe on docs/OBSERVABILITY-BASELINES.md 3a, so the row closes by itself the moment the five monthly figures and the snapshot month are pasted in, with no re-read needed. The ask is unchanged: open the current invoice for Supabase, Vercel, Anthropic, Resend and Upstash, put each monthly USD figure in the Monthly spend column, and add a line stating the snapshot month (for example: Snapshot month: September 2026). 3b stays gated on 1,000 profiles (61 profiles on 2026-10-05, read on production).

RULED 2026-10-05 by owner, multiple choice in the project thread (ADR-1705 §4): "Give me billing access" (the options were: paste them now, give me billing access, wait for revenue). The owner grants the agent a read on each vendor's billing rather than pasting figures. Vercel billing is readable through the connected Vercel account already; Supabase, Anthropic, Resend and Upstash have no billing read here, so the route is the invoice emails: the owner forwards or labels them in the connected Gmail, or adds a read-only billing member on each vendor. The probe is unchanged.

RULED 2026-10-05 (owner, project chat): add a billing viewer for Supabase and Upstash rather than pasting figures. Supabase: Dashboard > Organization > Billing > Billing email, set to the Gmail Claude reads (or invite that address to the org as a member so it can open Billing). Upstash: Console > Account > Billing, set the billing email, or Team > invite that address. Once invoices land in that inbox the 3a snapshot is filled from them each month and the probe closes.
